example-pages: Label under the number of articles in the community header.
example-discuss: Accessible name of the community discussion control.
example-theme-light: Accessible label for switching to the light theme.
example-theme-dark: Accessible label for switching to the dark theme.
example-width: Accessible name of the article width toggle.
example-save: Label of the control to save an article.
example-page-tools: Accessible name of the page actions menu button.
example-sign-in: Label of the account sign-in link in the top bar.
example-create-account: Label of the registration link in the top bar.
example-home: Label of the main page link in the global navigation rail.
example-explore: Label of the all-pages link in the global navigation rail.
example-saved: Label of the saved pages control in the global navigation rail.
example-progress: Label of the reading progress control in the global navigation rail.
example-history: Label of the page revision history link in the global navigation rail.
example-utilities: Label of the special pages link in the global navigation rail.
example-network: Label of the Fandom network control in the global navigation rail.
example-settings: Label of the preferences link and the lower global navigation landmark.
example-more: Label of the additional options control in the global navigation rail.

example-recent-activity: Label for the Recent Wiki Activity control in the signed-in layout.
example-my-tools: Label for the My Tools control in the signed-in layout.
example-customize: Label for the Customize control in the signed-in layout.
example-shortcuts: Label for the Shortcuts control in the signed-in layout.
